description: Registers a new company in your client portal and makes you its owner. An account can create up to 3 companies. The company starts unverified; documents are uploaded on the website. Call without confirm first for a preview, then again with confirm and the preview_token.

confirm.description: Set true only on the second call, after the user approved the preview.

country.description: Country as 2 uppercase letters, e.g. IQ.

preview_token.description: The preview_token returned by the first call (same input).

name: company_create
title: Register a company
